layout.note: The upstream release ships parquet shards per split with an inline image column. The download script materializes them into the per-file layout the adapter reads; within a multi-shard split the document number is the cumulative row offset in filename-sorted shard order, so cord-train-0000..cord-train-0799 is deterministic given the pinned shard set.

ground_truth.notes: Word-level receipt annotation with four-corner quads rather than axis-aligned boxes, because receipt photographs are routinely skewed. A different transcription convention from FUNSD's form annotation and from OCR-D's diplomatic line transcription; the three tracks are reported separately.
